sections.workProcess: How I have organised my work process

join.name: Join
join.about: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks with drag-and-drop features, assign users and categories.
join.workProcess: Agile development with clear task distribution, Git version control and regular code reviews for high code quality.
join.groupWork: Team collaboration with daily sync-ups and joint problem solving.

pokedex.name: Pokédex
pokedex.about: An interactive Pokémon encyclopedia fetching data from the PokéAPI. Browse, filter and discover details about all Pokémon.
pokedex.workProcess: API integration with async requests, modular code structure and responsive design implementation.
pokedex.groupWork: Independent project focusing on clean, maintainable code.

elpolloloco.name: El Pollo Loco
elpolloloco.about: A jump-and-run browser game built with object-oriented JavaScript. Collect coins, throw bottles and defeat the crazy final boss chicken!
elpolloloco.workProcess: Object-oriented programming with classes, collision detection and game logic implementation.
elpolloloco.groupWork: Solo project with focus on game mechanics and animation.

whyme.headline: Why me
whyme.description: Why am I passionate about coding? I love solving complex problems through analytical thinking and creative approaches. My persistence drives me to keep going even with difficult challenges until I find the best solution. I value collaboration – because the best results come from working together. With my problem-solving mindset, I bring real value to every project.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: The protection of your personal data is of particular concern to me. I treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with legal data protection regulations and this privacy policy. This privacy policy informs you about the type, scope and purpose of the processing of personal data within my online offering and the websites, functions and content associated with it.

dataCollection.title: Collection and Storage of Personal Data
dataCollection.content: When you visit the website, information is automatically collected by the hosting provider that your browser transmits. These are: IP address, date and time of the request, time zone difference to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), content of the request (specific page), access status/HTTP status code, amount of data transferred in each case, website from which the request comes, browser, operating system and its interface, language and version of browser software. This data is stored in log files and deleted after 7 days.

contactForm.title: Contact Form
contactForm.content: When using the contact form, your information (name, email address, message) will be stored by me to process your request and in case of follow-up questions. I will not share this data without your consent. The processing is based on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR). You can revoke this consent at any time. The legality of the data processing operations that have already taken place remains unaffected by the revocation.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: This website does not use cookies. Should the use of cookies become necessary in the future, you will be informed here and can object to their use.

serverLogs.title: Server Log Files
serverLogs.content: The provider of this website automatically collects and stores information in server log files that your browser automatically transmits. These are: browser type and version, operating system used, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing computer, time of server request and IP address. This data is not merged with other data sources. The data is deleted after statistical evaluation after 7 days.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients as well as the purpose of data processing. You also have a right to correction, blocking or deletion of this data. For this purpose, as well as for further questions on the subject of data protection, you can contact me at any time at the address given in the legal notice. Furthermore, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: I use technical and organizational security measures to protect the data managed by me against accidental or intentional manipulation, loss, destruction or against access by unauthorized persons. My security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments.

changes.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
changes.content: I reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to implement changes to my services in the privacy policy. The new privacy policy will then apply to your next visit.
